issues.text: The lesson defines an invariant as a rule true 'whenever the data is saved' (section 3), and claim 12 says the Compose database has `CHECK (quantity > 0)` on order_items. Under that definition, code holding an order cannot save a quantity of 0; only the at-least-one-item rule can end up broken in saved data. What the C# types allow is putting the in-memory order into a state that breaks both rules.
